title: Word-Level Alignment of OCR and Ground Truth under Zoning and Reading-Order Errors
abstract: arXiv:2611.13752v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: OCR post-processing needs OCR text aligned word by word with its ground truth. Data sets rarely provide that mapping, and a monotone aligner can lose its place when zoning errors permute the reading order. We revisit this problem, the Zoning Problem of our 2019 paper, with a protocol that tests correctness under such permutations. We apply OCR-side reading-order permutations with construction-time word-level gold and score correct-match F1, cascade length and recovery. We compare the 2019 location-aware aligner, a re-anchoring extension of it, a RETAS-style baseline (RETAS-lite), a multi-region aligner that combines unique-word and unique n-gram anchors with chunk-to-window assignment, genalog's RETAS and the original Java RETAS. Experiments use synthetic character noise with block moves, paragraph swaps and column interleaving, historical newspaper reading-order permutations, geometry-derived gold for Tesseract OCR, and a small word-box

translated_title: 区域划分与阅读顺序错误下OCR与标准答案的词级对齐
translated_abstract: OCR后处理需要将OCR文本与其标准答案逐词对齐。数据集很少提供这种映射关系，而当区域划分错误打乱阅读顺序时，单调对齐器可能会失去对齐位置。我们重新审视了这一问题，即我们2019年论文中提出的区域划分问题，并设计了一种在这些顺序置换下测试正确性的评估协议。我们在OCR侧应用阅读顺序置换，结合构建时的词级黄金标准，以正确匹配F1值、级联长度和恢复率作为评分指标。我们比较了2019年的位置感知对齐器、其重锚定扩展版本、RETAS风格的基线（RETAS-lite）、一种结合独特单词与独特n-gram锚点以及块到窗口分配的多区域对齐器、genalog的RETAS以及原始Java RETAS。实验使用了包含块移动、段落交换和列交错的合成字符噪声、历史报纸的阅读顺序置换、为Tesseract OCR导出的几何黄金标准，以及一个小型词框数据集。
tldr: 本文重新审视了OCR文本与标准答案的词级对齐问题，提出了一种在区域划分和阅读顺序错误（置换）下评估对齐器正确性的协议，并系统比较了多种对齐方法在阅读顺序扰动下的性能表现。
en_tdlr: This paper revisits word-level alignment between OCR output and ground truth, proposing an evaluation protocol that tests aligner correctness under zoning and reading-order permutations, and systematically compares multiple alignment methods under such order disruptions.
